facts.subject: Bring a matching Persona
facts.notes: Use a Persona of the relevant Arcana for links that need affinity. Do not infer a guaranteed rank-up from rank alone.

facts.subject: Combine rescues when feasible
facts.notes: Suggest a visit after the last person in a batch arrives, with time to spare before the earliest deadline. Player strength and available evenings must override efficiency.

facts.subject: Linked Episodes need repeated opportunities
facts.notes: Do not treat the final calendar date in an interval as a guaranteed available meeting. Encourage early completion and check in-game availability.

facts.subject: Use school days for school links
facts.notes: When no dated event is at risk, favour available school links over town links. This is a flexible priority, not an instruction to ignore a favourite character.

facts.subject: Visit the nurse after Tartarus
facts.notes: School-day access is necessary. Check the nurse after a Tartarus visit or full-moon operation; the guide reports a Courage benefit without using a time slot.

facts.subject: Evening affinity recovery
facts.notes: Evening affinity recovery is documented. Earliest purchase date is unknown here; inspect the dedicated shop source before using an unlock rule.

facts.subject: marendarade early Tartarus allocation
facts.notes: Author allows combining each pair if the player can finish the work. Do not require one-night dungeon clears for the semi-guide.
